body:
Stopped before claiming #1880 because required dependencies #1861 and #1862 are unavailable on an allowed base.
Upstream main 17a8c6e7608bb7078f75ec335361839712e51425 contains the DXF reader from #1860, but has no sketch chaining module or sketch entity/import command.
#1861 and #1862 remain open. The open-PR search found no PR for either dependency to stack on.
#1880 requires the SVG reader to reuse their sketch chains, nesting, entity, and import command. Implementing those prerequisites here would exceed the instruction to work only #1880.
No claim, branch, worktree, code change, pinning test, or gate run was made. The per-file overlap check was not started because the required integration APIs are absent.
The next attempt needs #1861 and #1862 on upstream/main or an eligible base within the one-level stacking limit.
